Keep awards/designations distinct; do not turn generic mention, donations, candidate opponents, or lists of candidates this person endorsed into endorsements OF this candidate. The generic boilerplate combines endorsements and recommendations: use the specific entry and its category. Do not rely on URL filenames alone. Hold ambiguous cases.
